original_context_note: Compared spec.full_target with target-selection.json/full_target and problem.md:19-48: the complete selected target, including the disclosed fixed-unit-vector perturbation interpretation, is preserved verbatim. Positive integer dimensions are represented by natural parameters with their positivity explicitly in H001, not granted through parameter refinements. H002 is joint smoothness, H003 is the original |q|=1, H004 is the pointwise unit constraint, H005 is pointwise existential normality with no scalar regularity, and H006 is support common to each closed positive-time slab. All six original conditions remain graph roots. H003 is unused; the proof needs q to be fixed, but not its unit norm. D001-D005 define exactly the componentwise temporal/spatial derivatives and their indices; their total derivative conventions grant no regularity and agree with classical derivatives wherever the direct smoothness input applies. D006 is the componentwise Laplacian. D007 preserves precisely the original sum of norm squares, Frobenius identification, Lebesgue measure and normalization, and D008 merely names its derivative. D009 is guarded by N002's actual all-positive-time integrability, proved without E in R002; R003 and R005 both have N002 as a direct input before using E. All other definitions are total notation and have no existence guard. The nine selected native source contracts M001,M002,M003,M005-M010 were compared with successful full probe signatures and their defining source passages: filter dominated convergence; the convex-set derivative norm estimate; interval FTC with endpoint differentiability and integrable derivative; continuous compact-support integrability; derivative of an inner product; symmetry of the second derivative with the minSmoothness condition (its definition was also read); compact continuous norm bounds; measure-preserving coordinate extraction; and symmetric Fubini. Their normed-space, scalar, measure, countability and completeness premises are retained in their statements and applications. M004 was only a discovery probe, not a selected node. No external theorem is imported from Evans: that citation supplies the exercise identity in the frozen problem, not an extra proof premise, so no inaccessible primary theorem or deferred source is being assumed. The five producer units R001-R005 preserve all four original logical phases, including the explicit scalar equation calculation, domination/limit argument, coordinate FTC/Fubini calculation and final MVT constancy consequence; no material supplied calculation has been omitted. The graph's only roots are H and the nine selected M; every N and M lies in P's AND dependency closure and every N/P has exactly its displayed producer. The structural result is not mathematical acceptance; these are my same-author closing checks under the supplied shared criteria.
